conclusion: Frozen later:lookahead/branch-03 asks for general quadratic same-run specialization, including variable steps, not merely an affine fixed-step example. Existing accepted generic Bregman source_fixed_regret/source_variable_regret already cover the literal Theorem15.30 and its mandatory fixed-step exercise conditionally on valid source updates. Existing OnlinePrescientLinear is a useful affine fixed-step instance but does not reconcile the generic nonlinear/subdifferentiable quadratic branch.

minimal_required_math.statement: For psi(z)=||z||^2/2 in the existing shared divergence definition, B_psi(a;b)=||a-b||^2/2. Use existing Mathlib derivative/quadratic results; no duplicate divergence or per-Book algorithm.
minimal_required_math.role: Reusable algebra/derivative bridge, no regret result by itself.

minimal_required_math.statement: For arbitrary source-compatible extended-real loss sequence, positive played nonincreasing eta, natural T>0, any u in nonempty closed convex V, and a valid run of the existing Option iterate with quadratic regularizer: sum_{t<T}(loss_t(x_(t+1))-loss_t(u)) <= max_{t<T}||u-x_t||^2/(2 eta_(T-1)) - sum_{t<T}||x_(t+1)-x_t||^2/(2 eta_t).
minimal_required_math.role: Same actual shared producer as source15.30; no affine restriction or assumed desired bound.

minimal_required_math.statement: Under corresponding fixed eta>0 conditions, regret <= ||u-x0||^2/(2eta) - sum_{t<T}||x_(t+1)-x_t||^2/(2eta). T=0 may remain supported as in existing fixed source theorem.
minimal_required_math.role: Retain mandatory fixed-step source branch; derive from already accepted fixed Bregman endpoint and identity, not reprove telescoping. May be bundled with variable endpoint; no forced public helper chain.

source_hypotheses_and_information: Source losses exclude minus infinity globally and are finite on V (V subset effectiveDomain); retain nonempty support/subdifferentiability on V. Do not replace by globally finite differentiable losses or affine losses.
Preserve source nonempty closed convex V and valid minimizer/run assumptions. Existing SourceProper can be derived from no-bottom/domain/nonempty rather than silently strengthened.

Quadratic all-space ambient X=univ discharges interior/differentiability geometrically; explicitly label this specialization. For arbitrary X, retain source interior points and closedness/extension hypotheses instead of dropping them.
Prediction is x_(t+1) after observing whole current loss t, unlike causal OGD pre-update scoring. Initial state Lean0 is sourcex0; loss0 is sourceell1.

Use existing Option advance/iterate. Either conditional successful-run hseq or source hmin updates with proved uniqueness/iterate bridge is legitimate. No universal attainment or invented total selector; failure semantics remain none/absorbing.

Negative movement-square stability is not negative ordinary-gradient-square for arbitrary constrained/nonsmooth losses. The total upper bound need not be nonpositive because comparator potential remains.
